title: MiaucraftBridge remote configuration
description: Live behavior for the bridge plugin, fetched from GitHub. Edit + push this file to change collector behavior on every server without touching the jar.

$schema.description: Editor-only pointer to this schema. Ignored by the plugin.

version.description: Config schema version. The plugin refuses to apply a config with a newer version it does not understand.

enabled.description: Remote master switch. false stops every collector without a restart (the local config.yml kill switch still wins).

heartbeat-seconds.description: How often server_status_public.updated_at is refreshed. Must stay well under the website's 30s stale threshold.

events.description: React to in-game stat increments in real time.

additionalProperties.description: Keys to keep for this stat category, or ["all"] to keep everything. Adding a new key here collects it without a plugin restart.

progress-scan-seconds.description: How often online players' progress is queued for a scan. The scan itself is spread over ticks.

offline-scan-seconds.description: How often the on-disk advancement files are read for offline players.

flush-delay-ms.description: How long a chat message may wait for a flush of its own before the shared 5s cycle. Lower = more live, and near-zero cost: rows are batched either way, only the timing changes. Clamped to 0-5000, one tick (50ms) is the floor.

max-length.description: Longest stored chat message; longer messages are clipped.

web-prefix.description: Text before each relayed website message. Edit + push to change the format live.

web-prefix-color.description: Named colour (aqua, dark_gray, ...) or hex (#55ffdd) for web-prefix. Empty = aqua.

web-body-format.description: Template for the rest of the line. Placeholders: {username}, {message}.

web-body-color.description: Named colour or hex for the username+message body. Empty = white.
